item.title: Worlds largest electric ship launched by Tasmanian boatbuilder
item.description:

item.title: If childhood is half of subjective life, how should that change how we live?
item.description:
📝 If you take this model literally, that your experience of an interval reflects what fraction of your life the interval is, then we experience time logarithmically through our lives. Instead of worrying that the weeks are all forgettable, as you might have in your former life, you instead worry that you will forget. Then start the firsts that you do remember and that you can recreate for them.
🔗 Read more: https://moultano.wordpress.com/2025/12/30/children-and-helical-time/
